typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CID as integer,
		ExtractDate as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '[PR_PHARMACY_90_DAY_FAX]
		@INPUT_FILE_NAME =',
	schemaName: '[APP_CPLS]',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(CID = CID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount derive(PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID = toInteger($PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		CID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID,
		TRANSFER_STATUS,
		CID)) ~> OLEDBDestination
